discrepancies_resolved.issue: Narrative precision discrepancies reported in user prompt (0.5204 vs 0.5354, 0.4460 vs 0.4459, 0.6401 vs 0.5940)
discrepancies_resolved.root_cause: Typographical/draft calculation errors in previous turn narrative text table. The underlying serialized phase3_results.json and prediction CSVs were mathematically exact and consistent with the confusion matrices: Tiny-GenImage = 0.5354, Frontier = 0.4459, WildAIGC = 0.5940.

discrepancies_resolved.issue: Artificially wide bootstrap confidence interval on Tiny-GenImage [0.4133, 0.8200]
discrepancies_resolved.root_cause: Phase 2 Step 3 grouped all 3,500 real ImageNet test images into a single group (tiny_genimage_val_ImageNet-Camera_ILSVRC2012). In unstratified group bootstrap with 2,001 groups, 34.3% of resamples omitted this single real group entirely (0 real samples). Stratified bootstrap yields the true valid 95% CI of [0.5426, 0.5614].

discrepancies_resolved.issue: Extremely high calibration temperature on WildAIGC T = 148.4123
discrepancies_resolved.root_cause: Negative correlation between detector margins and true labels on WildAIGC (r = -0.2310). Model assigned higher AI scores to Real images than AI images. NLL optimization pushed T -> infinity to maximize entropy (flat 0.5 probability), hitting the upper search bound exp(5.0) ≈ 148.4123.
